<noinclude>This is a list of [[side story episodes]], a series of special episodes that originally aired as part of the [[Weekly Pokémon Broadcasting Station]] in Japan. When dubbed, these side stories became part of [[Pokémon Chronicles]], alongside ''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]'' and several [[Pikachu short]]s.

[[Ash Ketchum]] is not featured in a central role in the side story episodes, which instead focus on the lives of {{ashfr}}, such as {{an|Brock}}, {{an|Misty}}, and {{Tracey}}, while Ash is off traveling the [[Hoenn]] region. The [[Team Rocket]] members featured are usually [[Butch]] and [[Cassidy]], in place of the [[Team Rocket trio|usual members Ash faces]].</noinclude>
